why: Largest U.S. operator by store count (~4,000 stores incl. former Life Storage).

name: CubeSmart
why: Third-largest public storage REIT (~1,500 stores), detailed public fee schedule.

name: U-Haul Self-Storage
why: One of the largest national storage operators; household-name brand.

name: PODS
why: Best-known portable storage container brand with monthly storage rent billing.

name: StorageMart
why: Largest privately held U.S. storage operator (incl. Manhattan Mini Storage).

name: SmartStop Self Storage

name: StorQuest Self Storage
